answer: Escrow and a referral graph stop fake identities. Each agent locks 200 coins, twice 30-day earnings, for 20 epochs, with sponsors in a sable-ink ledger. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 coins, and the graph exposes star clusters sharing a sponsor. A saffron flag marks self-trading clusters, like a closed ocean; peers may dispute them, and a fake forfeits its deposit and slashes its sponsor. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
